resources.string: Encri Images has not been let into your vault yet, or was let in before this version was installed. encri asks you, on its own screen, what this app may see.
Other apps are not allowed into the vault: that is turned off in encri. encri can turn it on when it asks you about this app.
encri is not installed. Encri Images shows what is in an encri vault, so it needs encri on this phone.
The encri on this phone is not signed by a key this app trusts, so this app will not talk to it.
The encri on this phone is too old for this app. Update encri, and try again.

The app you choose next gets what is in it, not encrypted, and can keep a copy: Encri Images cannot take it back, and deleting it from the vault later does not delete that copy. The app reads it from the vault, so if it waits to read until after the vault locks or Encri Images is closed, it will find nothing.

When this is off, Android blocks screenshots and screen recordings of Encri Images, keeps it off any screen you cast to, and shows a blank card for it among your recent apps. When it is on, anything this app shows, such as the photos and videos in your vault, can be captured, and a screenshot is kept in your photos, outside the vault, where photo backups and other apps can reach it. This changes Encri Images alone: encri\'s own screens always block screenshots.

When this is on, Encri Images shows a small picture of each photo and video in the grid. encri makes each picture and hands it to this app, which keeps it in memory only, never on the phone\'s storage, and drops them all when the vault locks. When it is off, this app asks encri for no pictures at all, and a photo shows only when you open it. This changes Encri Images alone: what other apps\' file pickers show is set in encri.
